params.prompt: Cinematic photoreal still life, square 1:1. A 1990s desk at night: an old beige dial-up modem with glowing amber status LEDs, a coiled phone cable, a used scratched prepaid internet card and a beige CRT monitor glowing softly behind, a desk lamp. Nostalgic, quiet. The upper 50% of the frame is nearly black and empty for typography. No people. Deep coffee-brown shadows (#0B0907), warm practical light, subtle yellow (#FDD506) accent glow, thin haze. No readable text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no green.
